tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with a slightly elevated erythrocyte count and normal red cell indices, suggesting possible early iron deficiency or thalassemia trait. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and distribution width are elevated, which may indicate increased platelet turnover or activation. Further clinical correlation and iron studies are recommended.
